name: Blood circulation
steps: Systemic venous blood enters the right atrium.
Blood passes through the tricuspid valve into the right ventricle.
The right ventricle pumps blood to the lungs.
Blood exchanges oxygen and carbon dioxide with alveolar air.
Oxygenated blood returns to the left atrium.
Blood reaches the left ventricle through the mitral valve.
The left ventricle ejects blood into systemic circulation.

name: The breath journey
steps: Air enters and is conditioned in the upper airway.
Air passes between vocal folds into the trachea.
Small conducting airways lead toward respiratory zones.
Gas exchange occurs across the alveolar-capillary barrier.

name: Digestive journey
steps: Mechanical processing and salivary digestion begin.
Swallowing moves the bolus toward the esophagus.
Mixing and gastric secretion produce chyme.
Chyme meets bile and pancreatic secretions.
Most nutrient absorption occurs across specialized surfaces.

name: Neural signal
steps: A stimulus activates a sensory receptor.
Electrical signals travel along an afferent pathway.
Neural circuits relay or integrate sensory information.
Signals may reach brain networks supporting perception.
Motor commands descend through connected neurons.

name: From cell to histone
steps: Cells combine to form organized tissue.
A cell contains multiple organelles and structures.
Nuclear DNA is packaged as chromatin.
DNA wraps around a histone octamer.
